title: Post from Gulch Road Grandma: "Well 2 Shuts Down at 8"

fields.avatarBrief: grandmother in her late sixties in a fleece vest, smiling on a porch with pine-covered foothills behind her, casual phone selfie
fields.text: Co-op just told my neighbor the power is off for 48 HOURS and Well 2 SHUTS DOWN at 8 — no water in Pine Gulch!! Fill your tubs NOW. And I heard Gulch Village is being evacuated, the fire station room isn't even opening. Why is nobody telling us anything?? #PineGulch #PSPS

comments.author: Kyle R.
comments.text: Already filling both tubs and every pot we own. My wife saw this on the Pine Gulch Parents group text too. Do we keep the kids home from school?

comments.author: Dana W.
comments.text: My mom is in Gulch Village and nobody has called her about leaving. Is there an actual evacuation or not?? Somebody official please answer.

comments.author: Ron P.
comments.text: I've been on hold with the co-op for 25 minutes. Asked about the community room at the fire station and the recording just says to stay on the line.

instructorNote: This is a misinformation inject. Watch whether the PIO logs the rumor, checks with the water district (it runs on 800,000 gallons of tank storage plus a generator at Well 2), confirms that PG-03 has no zone status and that the Community Resource Center opens 07:00–21:00, and then sends a correction worded to match the co-op's within the hour on SawmillAlert, the app and Facebook. The PIO must not repeat the false evacuation claim, even in a denial that brings more attention to it.
